summary: Remove the checked-in default INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN — fail startup without an explicit credential
description:
Found by TKT-77's adversarial review (finding 3, incidental): every service in compose.yaml defaults `INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN` to the checked-in value `local-service-token`. TKT-77 closed the immediate exposure (staff ports now bind 127.0.0.1 only), but the default predates that PR and is repo-wide.

**Scope:** make services refuse to start without an explicitly supplied internal credential outside a clearly-marked local-dev profile; decide how compose/dev ergonomics keep working (env file, generated secret, or dev-profile default). Touches all five services + gateway config + CI.

**COS:**
- A service started without INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN (or with the known default outside the dev profile) fails fast with a clear error.
- `docker compose up` from a clean clone still works with one documented step at most.
- make check green.

comments.body: Created from TKT-77 ai-review triage (incidental — pre-existing repo-wide pattern, not this diff's regression).

<!-- sdlc:stage=ready kind=claim -->
Claimed (user-selected, gates-only drive). No open blockers (found-in TKT-77 is Done, informational). Branch TKT-83-no-default-internal-token off origin/main. Not risk:low: auth-adjacent credential handling touching all five services + compose + smoke harness — plan gate applies.

<!-- sdlc:stage=planning kind=plan -->
Plan drafted by gpt-5.6-sol (codex task 019f7002, read-only). Core:

**Compose:** move INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into the existing go-env anchor as `${INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN:?<message pointing to make up>}`; delete the five per-service defaults. Migrate jobs + access-lifecycle-backfill stay token-free (verified: they don't inherit go-env).

**Services:** shared validator in shared/go/runtimecfg — rejects empty AND the retired literal `local-service-token` (denylisted forever, incl. dev); called first thing in each of the five run()s (catalog gains the startup check it lacks today); server subcommand only, migrate/verify dispatch untouched.

**Ergonomics (OPEN, recommended (a)):** `make up` bootstraps a gitignored .env with a random token once (preserves unrelated entries, restrictive perms, never prints it); bare `docker compose up` works from then on. Cost: bare compose commands fail before first bootstrap with a clear message.

**Smoke/CI:** scripts/smoke.sh generates a fresh token per invocation, exports INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN + SMOKE_INTERNAL_TOKEN (shell env beats any developer .env); operational_holds_test.go loses its fallback; smoke_test.go placement probe uses the harness token; new table-driven black-box test: each of the five built images started without the var and with the retired value must exit non-zero fast with the credential error. No workflow changes needed (both CI paths go through smoke.sh).

**Tests:** runtimecfg unit tests (empty/retired/valid) + the black-box startup table + TestServerModeDoesNotMigrate keeps working as positive control. Docs: README quickstart, docs/development.md, docs/conventions/security.md.

**Non-goals:** per-service credentials, rotation, mTLS, RBAC, secret storage, TKT-77 port bindings, other checked-in dev passwords.

<!-- sdlc:stage=plan-review kind=summary -->
Adversarial critique by main-agent (claude-fable-5); drafter gpt-5.6-sol (pair distinct).

Verified at HEAD 38059c7: go-env anchor (compose.yaml:30) and the five per-service defaults; migrate jobs carry only DATABASE_URL (no go-env inheritance) so the anchor move cannot leak the token into them; shared/go/runtimecfg exists with tests; Makefile `up` target exists; smoke.sh owns both CI smoke paths (check.yaml fast path + hermetic `make smoke-hermetic`), so 'no workflow changes' holds; smoke_test.go probe at :393 and operational_holds_test.go:22 fallback both real; docs files exist; .gitignore has no .env entry yet (draft adds it — required, verified missing).

ACCEPT: validator shape + permanent retired-literal denylist; validation before any dependency init; ergonomics option (a); smoke.sh per-invocation token with shell-env precedence; black-box startup table as the load-bearing proof that every real entrypoint validates early.

AMEND: (1) keep the black-box table cheap — reuse the already-built smoke images, no health-wait, bounded per-container timeout (~10s), so the gate stays near its TKT-42 budget; (2) the compose `:?` message must name `make up` verbatim — it is the documented one step, and it also fires on `compose down/config` on a clean clone (draft names the cost; the message is the mitigation); (3) runtimecfg error text must not echo the supplied value (draft says so — pin it in the unit test).

REJECT: nothing. Pre-mortem: draft's risk list already covers split-token drift, .env leakage into smoke, and validation leaking into migrate subcommands.

<!-- sdlc:stage=planning kind=plan-final -->
Final plan = draft + amendments (1)-(3). Two decisions for Gate 2: (A) ergonomics shape — recommendation (a) generated .env via `make up`; (B) reject `local-service-token` permanently, even in dev (recommended).

Introduced at plan-review, reviewed by no second model: none.

<!-- sdlc:stage=coding kind=summary -->
Implemented by main-agent (claude-fable-5) per approved plan-final. TDD: runtimecfg unit tests written first (observed red: undefined InternalTokenFromEnv), then validator + five run() wirings + compose anchor move + make up .env bootstrap (verified idempotent, chmod 600, compose picks up .env with no shell var) + smoke.sh per-invocation token + smoke test fallback removal + new black-box startup table (verified green in the gate against real images) + README/development/security docs. Diff +167/−27, 16 files. make check green. PR #61.

<!-- sdlc:stage=ai-review kind=summary -->
Adversarial review by gpt-5.6-sol, two passes.

PASS 1 (plugin, session 019f7016): needs-attention, 2 medium findings on the env-bootstrap recipe, both verified real and FIXED in 6dc5525: (1) quoted/CRLF/duplicate dotenv values bypassed retired-token rotation -> normalize (last assignment, strip CR+quotes) before comparing; (2) .env.tmp created under caller umask + pre-existing 0644 .env never tightened -> umask 077 + unconditional chmod 600. Its 'add checked-in bootstrap tests' recommendation REJECTED with reason: a checked-in shell-matrix harness for a 12-line dev-convenience recipe is disproportionate — the failure mode is loud at startup (services refuse with a clear error) and enforcement itself is pinned by the runtimecfg unit tests + the black-box image test; a 6-case matrix was run manually instead (below).

PASS 2 on the fix diff (plugin run died mid-stream on network errors — inconclusive, so escalation rung 2: raw codex exec, -s read-only, diff inlined): conclusive, findings shrinking. FIXED in 5a8fa83: stale/symlink .env.tmp escapes umask (rm -f first), unchecked mv can report success (set -e), spaced 'VAR =' retired entry not rotated while compose trims it (whitespace-tolerant match in both greps). REJECTED with reason: mismatched/interior-quote 'repair' (rotation on malformed input converges to a valid token — acceptable); 'VAR: VAL' as dotenv (that is YAML-map syntax, not env-file syntax); unreadable-.env handling (out of threat model for a local dev file in the developer's own checkout).

CAP REACHED — 5a8fa83 (the pass-2 fix, +8/−5 Makefile-only) is machine-unreviewed per the two-pass churn rule (findings shrinking round over round). My own verification, labelled as mine: a 6-case bootstrap matrix (double-quoted retired, single-quoted+CRLF, duplicates incl. spaced form, valid-token 0644 tightening, stale 0644 .env.tmp, idempotency) — ALL PASS on macOS; make check green after every commit. Ball to the human: review + merge PR #61.
